bowl.geometry: concave interior and exterior wall; decoration must respect rim, well and curvature

plate.geometry: broad planar field with rim/border hierarchy

vase.geometry: continuous rotational body; motif scale changes across neck, shoulder and belly

jar.geometry: volumetric lidded/open vessel; broad shoulder and belly fields

tile.geometry: flat architectural or decorative surface; edge/chip logic matters

figurine.geometry: three-dimensional modeled figure; glaze/pigment follows modeled volume

bust.geometry: head, neck and upper torso; terminate deliberately at chest/shoulders or pedestal

free_standing_statue.geometry: 360-degree figure with load-bearing stance, base/contact logic and silhouette

relief.geometry: figures project from a backing plane; depth is compressed and undercuts are limited by relief type

funerary_stele.geometry: upright slab or marker combining carved/inscribed zones and architectural edge logic

architectural_frieze.geometry: horizontal narrative/decorative band designed for architectural viewing

scroll.geometry: elongated sequential viewing surface with mounting/border logic

album_leaf.geometry: bounded intimate picture field, often square/rectangular

book_page.geometry: page edges, margins, text/image hierarchy, binding relationship

folding_screen.geometry: image spans hinged panels; folds interrupt and rhythmically segment the scene

popup_diorama.geometry: layered cut/fold elements rise from a base; hinges/tabs and cast shadows are visible
